user.description: Pick a Granboard found over Bluetooth, or type its address (for example CA:0F:52:F5:55:47). Close the Granboard phone app first; the board takes one connection at a time.

error.invalid_address: That is not a Bluetooth address. Use six pairs like CA:0F:52:F5:55:47.

abort.already_configured: This Granboard is already set up.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a Granboard.

init.description: While a game is running, the button on the board moves to the next player. The Repeat Hit Window ignores a hit identical to the last one if it arrives this soon after it (0 turns it off). Light The Board On Hits blinks the board's LED ring in the player's colour on every dart, plays award effects and a circular wipe when the turn changes, like the Granboard app.
